value.rationale: The physical decision is which of two equal-measure endpoint cylinder holes to open at each predetermined time to maximize cumulative escape. A universal strict monotonicity principle gives the unique finite-horizon solution across every integer base, and shows that dynamic switching realizes the performance of a different, unavailable static non-self-overlapping cross-pair hole. The scalar count recurrence already occurs classically for that stationary cross-pair; value here is the complete restricted-control optimality and its binary double-root versus higher-base rate, not a claim that the sequence itself is new.
